G8 humanoid direct-authoring promotion — resolved PIVOT 2026-08-18
rules: Continue an active implementation PR before opening later core-lane or child-lane scope.
Do not advance the current child until its acceptance criteria and required checks are green.
Stop at unresolved owner gates documented in docs/DECISION_GATES.md; do not silently choose scope/product decisions.
Run preregistered engineering checkpoints before scored cohorts where specified.
Do not mutate, relabel, overwrite or rerun a frozen scored/negative evidence cohort merely to improve the recorded result.
Public pull-request CI must not execute on the owner home self-hosted runner.
Provider/model calls must be owner-triggered and bounded by a frozen experiment contract; portable CI remains provider-free.
G8 issue #119 is closed with owner REJECT + PIVOT. Do not reopen humanoid direct-authoring retries or H0-H3 schema expansion as ordinary continuation.
P11 is generator-neutral: RAW, external and TracePixel-direct candidates must converge on the same downstream Canvas/QA/review authority; generator identity is provenance, not canonical raster truth.
TracePixel-direct remains an optional backend/control and precision local-repair path, not the privileged production generator.
P11-X0 is contract-only and must perform zero new provider generation calls.

P11-X1 must define an owner-operated state machine with frozen experiment -> owner-triggered run -> awaiting-owner-review -> accepted|repair-requested|rejected-stop, and must reuse existing P7 human-feedback authority where it fits.
When state is awaiting-owner-review, autonomous continuation must surface exact artifacts, deterministic QA, cost evidence and frozen perceptual criteria and must stop before another provider call.

Owner feedback may be natural language; agents must bind it to the exact reviewed artifact and interpret unspecified criteria conservatively rather than inventing success/failure or region/stage hints.

Deterministic QA green never implies aesthetic/product PASS. Anatomy, identity, material readability, motion quality, pixel-cluster craft and overall taste remain perceptual/human unless a narrower objective fact is separately frozen.

Do not implement an autonomous aesthetic-score-until-threshold regeneration loop. Cheap exact deterministic normalization may repeat provider-free; provider repair/regeneration is allowed only within the preregistered bounded budget.
P11-X2 should prioritize cheap objective QA/normalization before expensive perceptual review and must add only workload-justified exact checks.
P11-X3 should prefer bounded local repair tied to exact owner feedback and preserve unaffected pixels where required; full regeneration is a separate explicit budgeted action.
P11-B0 must freeze the 128x128 static task, candidate backends, matched information, provider/model settings, budgets, deterministic checks, human criteria and retention before P11-B1 runs.
P11-B1 must keep human-visible quality and provider/Agent cost as separate result layers and preserve every unsuccessful attempt.

G9 direct animation, unrestricted 128x128 expansion, additional humanoid schema/skeleton/IK/physics, a new direct-generation architecture and Trace2D integration remain blocked until P11-P0 plus the relevant explicit owner gate.

P11-P0 must ask the owner whether evidence supports static production expansion, a 32x32 animation/sprite-sheet benchmark, keeping direct authoring only as repair/control, retiring more direct generation, G10 integration evaluation, or project contraction; no option is automatic.
Existing P1 Canvas, P2 PixelProgram/replay, P4 QA, P7 feedback/repair/human-review and P6/P8 review-package seams must be reused before creating a competing authority.
External projects such as PerfectPixel and sprite-gen are references/candidate backends, not code to clone, vendor or integrate without an active-lane need and current license/version review.
Trace2D integration remains deferred until independent P11 evidence and explicit G10 owner approval justify it.
